long_description: Brainstorm, create, publish and manage content and advertisements on social media using 1 tool.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Cofounder and CEO of Friz 

I started my career at Mastercard, building credit card for small businesses. My experience working with large SME credit card issuers like DBS, OCBC, UOB , BNI and BNP helped me realise the struggle freelancers face with financial services. I am passionate about empowering freelancers in Asia, a large percentage of whom are women. I have also filed 2 patents; in digital payments and credit scoring and love working to innovate in fintech.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder & CTO of Friz. Prior to Friz, Ash has been working at PPRO and DBS Bank as a Software Engineer on various financial products and services.  He was the first engineer in PPRO APAC and was integral in setting up the initial technical infrastructure and building the engineering team.

launches.title: Friz - AI social media manager
launches.tagline: Friz helps DTC brands automate brainstorming, creating, editing and scheduling content and ads.
launches.body:
Friz is an AI social media manager that helps DTC brands automate brainstorming, creating, editing and scheduling content and ads.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=77520&key=user_uploads/576527/c61426a8-205d-4ef8-a6da-32408fd9b912)

👨‍💻 Receive contextual posts and ads for your target audience and industry

💡 Go from prompt to post with visuals and captions in your brand style

🚀 Manage your entire calendar across various social media accounts from 1 place

Our mission is to save your marketing teams time and money while growing conversions and revenue ([www.usefriz.com](http://www.usefriz.com)).\
Support us on Product Hunt: <https://www.producthunt.com/posts/friz-2>
